name: reverse chest stretch
description: A seated chest stretch with the hands supported on a box behind the body, opening the chest and front shoulders.
instructions: Sit on the floor in front of a sturdy box with your knees bent and feet planted.
Place your hands on the box behind you with your fingers in a comfortable direction.
Move your hips slightly forward and lift your chest until you feel a gentle stretch across the front of your shoulders and chest.
Breathe steadily, hold briefly, then move back to release the stretch.
